say:2:1560311001:0.text: Alright, sleepyheads, rise and shine! The celebration's about to begin!
say:2:1560311001:0.source_cn: 亲爱的们，快点起床，庆典就要开始咯！

say:4:1560311002:0.text: Wh-what? Chippy was only asleep for a minute, and now the celebration's already starting?
say:4:1560311002:0.source_cn: 什、什么！满满只是稍微闭了一会眼睛，怎么庆典都要开始了！

say:6:1560311003:1.text: Huh...? But the sky's still so bright outside...
say:6:1560311003:1.source_cn: 唔……外面天明明还很亮呀。

say:7:1560311004:1.text: Just kidding, sweethearts. If I didn't wake you up like that, you'd probably sleep until noon.
say:7:1560311004:1.source_cn: 开个玩笑，亲爱的。不这么叫你们的话，恐怕你们要睡到中午...

say:8:1560311005:0.text: Come on now, everyone's waiting for you in the hall!
say:8:1560311005:0.source_cn: 快起来吧，朋友们都在大厅等你们呢！
say:8:1560311005:0.male: Come on now, everyone's waiting for you in the hall!
say:8:1560311005:0.female: Come on now, everyone's waiting for you in the hall!

choice_prompt:9:1560311005.text: Come on now, everyone's waiting for you in the hall!
choice_prompt:9:1560311005.source_cn: 快起来吧，朋友们都在大厅等你们呢！
choice_prompt:9:1560311005.male: Come on now, everyone's waiting for you in the hall!
choice_prompt:9:1560311005.female: Come on now, everyone's waiting for you in the hall!

say:11:1560311006:0.text: Since early this morning, so many guests have arrived, and we've got a mountain of packages. The hall's packed to the brim, there's barely room to move!
say:11:1560311006:0.source_cn: 是啊。今天一大早，旅店就来了好多客人，还收到了一堆包裹...
say:11:1560311006:0.male: Since early this morning, so many guests have arrived, and we've got a mountain of packages. The hall's packed to the brim, there's barely room to move!
say:11:1560311006:0.female: Since early this morning, so many guests have arrived, and we've got a mountain of packages. The hall's packed to the brim, there's barely room to move!

say:12:1560311007:0.text: Must be our friends who accepted the invitation! Magister, let's go take a look!
say:12:1560311007:0.source_cn: 肯定是接下邀请，来参加宴会的朋友们！主人，我们快去看看吧！
say:12:1560311007:0.male: Must be our friends who accepted the invitation! Magister, let's go take a look!
say:12:1560311007:0.female: Must be our friends who accepted the invitation! Magister, let's go take a look!

say:13:1560311008:1.text: You lead Chippy and Hammie into the hall, and the laughter, chatter, and mouthwatering smells of food hit you all at once. Everyone's eyes turn to you.
say:13:1560311008:1.source_cn: 你牵着满满和漫漫走入大厅。欢笑声、喧闹声与食物的香气一...
say:13:1560311008:1.male: You lead Chippy and Hammie into the hall, and the laughter, chatter, and mouthwatering smells of food hit you all at once. Everyone's eyes turn to you.
say:13:1560311008:1.female: You lead Chippy and Hammie into the hall, and the laughter, chatter, and mouthwatering smells of food hit you all at once. Everyone's eyes turn to you.

say:15:1560311009:0.text: Finally, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You're here! The general bought so much food. If you'd come any later, I'm not sure I could've held myself back.
say:15:1560311009:0.male: Finally, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You're here! The general bought so much food. If you'd come any later, I'm not sure I could've held myself back.
say:15:1560311009:0.female: Finally, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! You're here! The general bought so much food. If you'd come any later, I'm not sure I could've held myself back.

say:18:1560311011:1.text: Old friend! I heard you're collecting local specialties, so we brought the Winter Carnival roast chicken, a specialty of Holistone.
say:18:1560311011:1.source_cn: 老朋友，听说你正在收集各地的特产，我们特意带了圣石镇特...
say:18:1560311011:1.male: Old friend! I heard you're collecting local specialties, so we brought the Winter Carnival roast chicken, a specialty of Holistone.
say:18:1560311011:1.female: Old friend! I heard you're collecting local specialties, so we brought the Winter Carnival roast chicken, a specialty of Holistone.

say:21:1560311012:1.text: Ah, it smells amazing! Thank you, General Hogan.
say:21:1560311012:1.source_cn: 呀，闻着就好香！谢谢你，霍根将军。

say:24:1560311014:0.text: Hehe, of course, Chippy's tomato-stuffed meat rolls and wheat bread.
say:24:1560311014:0.source_cn: 呵呵，当然还有满满的番茄酿肉卷和小麦面包。

say:25:1560311015:0.text: Yay! Chippy's going to eat like a king tonight!
say:25:1560311015:0.source_cn: 好耶！满满晚上要大吃一顿！

say:28:1560311016:0.text: Chippy, there's plenty, but you've got to pace yourself. You don't want to overdo it and feel miserable later.
say:28:1560311016:0.source_cn: 满满，美味虽然很多，但还是要注意克制，小心又吃撑难受哦。

say:30:1560311018:0.text: How could I miss your Winter Carnival celebration?
say:30:1560311018:0.source_cn: 你们举办的隆冬节庆典，我怎么能不参加呢？
say:30:1560311018:0.male: How could I miss your Winter Carnival celebration?
say:30:1560311018:0.female: How could I miss your Winter Carnival celebration?

say:31:1560311019:1.text: Pandora's been helping me these past few days, and we've created a new drink for the festival—a Winter Carnival special.
say:31:1560311019:1.source_cn: 这几天潘多拉小姐帮忙，我们一起研究了新的调饮——隆冬节特调。

say:32:1560311020:0.text: I brought all the ingredients with me. I'll make it during the celebration—it's perfect for balancing out the richness of the roasted meats.
say:32:1560311020:0.source_cn: 我把材料都带来了，庆典时给大家现场调制，正好可以为烤肉解腻。

say:36:1560311022:0.text: Yep, right over there. Special roast meat shipped in from Ashen Wastes just this morning. How many beasts did you hunt?
say:36:1560311022:0.source_cn: 喏，都在那里。今天一早，从荒角沙漠寄来的特色烤肉。你们...
say:36:1560311022:0.male: Yep, right over there. Special roast meat shipped in from Ashen Wastes just this morning. How many beasts did you hunt?
say:36:1560311022:0.female: Yep, right over there. Special roast meat shipped in from Ashen Wastes just this morning. How many beasts did you hunt?

say:37:1560311023:0.text: And there's another pile of specialties from Sal'thorin...
say:37:1560311023:0.source_cn: 旁边的另一堆特产是从萨洛克兰寄来的……嗯，没听说过的名字。

say:38:1560311024:0.text: There's a card attached. Says it's for the dear magister's help in teaching customs.
say:38:1560311024:0.source_cn: 上面附了张卡片，说是给亲爱的指导老师的学费。
say:38:1560311024:0.male: There's a card attached. Says it's for the dear magister's help in teaching customs.
say:38:1560311024:0.female: There's a card attached. Says it's for the dear magister's help in teaching customs.

say:39:1560311025:0.text: So many... hmph, Chippy will forgive Ravion for tricking us into carrying all those bags.
say:39:1560311025:0.source_cn: 这么多……哼，满满勉强原谅沙利叶忽悠主人拎包了。
say:39:1560311025:0.male: So many... hmph, Chippy will forgive Ravion for tricking us into carrying all those bags.
say:39:1560311025:0.female: So many... hmph, Chippy will forgive Ravion for tricking us into carrying all those bags.

say:40:1560311026:0.text: Impressive, I've never had this many packages show up at once. Look, we're already running out of table space in the hall!
say:40:1560311026:0.source_cn: 不愧是你，我这店开到现在，还从没一次性接收过这么多快递...
say:40:1560311026:0.male: Impressive, I've never had this many packages show up at once. Look, we're already running out of table space in the hall!
say:40:1560311026:0.female: Impressive, I've never had this many packages show up at once. Look, we're already running out of table space in the hall!

say:43:1560311027:0.text: No space left? Well, that's a problem. Where am I supposed to put my signature damedangler fish head?
say:43:1560311027:0.source_cn: 没空位了？那就麻烦了。那我的冥湾美人特制鱼头放哪里？

say:44:1560311028:0.text: Sinbad! Dura above... you really brought that giant fish head here?
say:44:1560311028:0.source_cn: 辛巴达！艾雅在上……你、你真的把这个巨大的鱼头扛来了？

say:45:1560311029:0.text: Of course, when I promise something, I deliver. What do you think? "Specialty" enough?
say:45:1560311029:0.source_cn: 那当然，我辛巴达一向说到做到。怎么样，这个够特色了吧？

say:46:1560311030:1.text: As you're chatting, a huge bouquet suddenly bursts into view.
say:46:1560311030:1.source_cn: 在你们说话的空隙，一大团花束突然冲到了面前。
say:46:1560311030:1.male: As you're chatting, a huge bouquet suddenly bursts into view.
say:46:1560311030:1.female: As you're chatting, a huge bouquet suddenly bursts into view.

say:49:1560311032:0.text: The bouquet trembles... and out pop two bunny ears!
say:49:1560311032:0.source_cn: 花束颤动了一下……从里面弹出来了两只兔耳朵！

say:51:1560311033:0.text: It's me, it's me! We heard you were collecting flowers for the celebration, so everyone wanted to pitch in.
say:51:1560311033:0.source_cn: 是我，是我啦。听说你要办庆典要收集花朵来装饰，大家都抢...
say:51:1560311033:0.male: It's me, it's me! We heard you were collecting flowers for the celebration, so everyone wanted to pitch in.
say:51:1560311033:0.female: It's me, it's me! We heard you were collecting flowers for the celebration, so everyone wanted to pitch in.

say:52:1560311034:0.text: Lyca, Eironn, Bryon, Florabelle... Arden, Granny Dahnie, Damian, Parisa...
say:52:1560311034:0.source_cn: 莱卡、埃隆、布莱恩、芙拉贝尔……雅顿老师、达赫妮婆婆，...

say:53:1560311035:0.text: Everyone wrote blessings for you. I'll gather them up and give them to you later!
say:53:1560311035:0.source_cn: 大家都写了祝福信，回头我一起给你！
say:53:1560311035:0.male: Everyone wrote blessings for you. I'll gather them up and give them to you later!
say:53:1560311035:0.female: Everyone wrote blessings for you. I'll gather them up and give them to you later!

say:56:1560311036:1.text: With all the guests here and the celebration materials nearly ready, it's time to get things rolling.

choice_prompt:57:1560311036.text: With all the guests here and the celebration materials nearly ready, it's time to get things rolling.
choice_prompt:57:1560311036.source_cn: 宾客都到齐了，用来布置庆典的材料也准备得差不多，现在就正式布置了。

say:58:1560311037:0.text: Faramor said there were still some pesky Hypofiends around Cedartown. Once he clears them out, he'll be here.
say:58:1560311037:0.source_cn: 法拉莫尔说雪松镇附近还有一批活跃的魔物，清理好了就来参...

say:61:1560311038:0.text: Chippy will go help deal with the Hypofiends! Hmm... but Chippy also wants to stay and help prepare the celebration...
say:61:1560311038:0.source_cn: 那满满去帮忙清理魔物吧！唔……但我也想参与庆典的布置……

say:66:1560311040:0.text: Then... Chippy will get right on it! Thanks, Magister!
say:66:1560311040:0.source_cn: 那……那满满就不客气了！谢谢主人！
say:66:1560311040:0.male: Then... Chippy will get right on it! Thanks, Magister!
say:66:1560311040:0.female: Then... Chippy will get right on it! Thanks, Magister!

say:70:1560311042:0.source_cn: 你漫步在雪松镇的郊外。松针埋在泥中，厚厚地覆着一层雪。
